notes.title: ‌May 5th Update Notes:‌
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added ducks and chicks to the scenes.
[*] Expanded the range of skills.

notes.title: ‌April 30th Update Notes‌ 2
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where the time slowed down after completing the boss level and switching to the menu.

notes.title: ‌April 30th Update Notes‌
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the testers for your feedback!

‌Issues Fixed:‌

Fixed an issue where opening the settings menu (Esc) did not pause the game, and the player character became unresponsive after respawning following death.
Other interaction-related optimizations.
